edge_mode_rows.edge_or_center_object: Boundary charge, algebra center, soft mode, edge mode, observer energy, modular/relative-entropy offset, detector threshold, survey bin, foreground mask, benchmark namespace, or metadata label that affects the route split for FAMILYC-EW-CODE.
edge_mode_rows.center_choice_or_edge_rule: Declare the commutative center separately from noncommuting factor blocks and edge-mode algebras. Name sector projectors, sector-weight law, factor algebra in each sector, center/edge convention, the fixed carrier, the common sector instrument/decoder, and whether off-diagonal sector coherence belongs to the target algebra before spending entropy or recovery language.
edge_mode_rows.entropy_or_readout_effect: State whether the edge/center changes entropy, mutual information, generalized entropy, recovery maps, conservation budgets, anomaly matching, detector readout, likelihood normalization, benchmark leakage, or only metadata custody.
edge_mode_rows.center_failure_mode: Failure can appear as center-choice-dependent entropy, omitted edge modes, double-counted soft charges, treating p-stationary center transport as control of noncommuting factor blocks, demanding coherence outside a declared direct-sum algebra, hiding destructive or average-only sector routing, observer-energy offsets treated as physical entropy, detector thresholds becoming theory support, or metadata labels counted as physical centers.
edge_mode_rows.center_test: Vary the center/edge convention and sector weights, then independently rotate within-sector modular frames and perturb the common sector instrument on the fixed carrier. Verify center-relative inflow, factor-block operator-log control, OAQEC commutant residual, nondemolition routing, worst-sector confusion, and any separately claimed coherence recovery.
edge_mode_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer entropy recovery, factorization, edge-mode completeness, algebraic locality, or candidate-native public records from a center choice, edge extension, threshold, bin, or type-II/crossed-product trace convention alone.
